evals.prompt: We should do something about onboarding drop-off. Turn this into a proposal.
evals.expected_output: An idea document with five to seven options, one line per death, one chosen direction plus a runner-up, the riskiest assumption, and the cheapest test. Only docs/ideas changes.
expectations: The document lists at least five different options with a cost and an assumption each.
Every rejected option has a one-line reason it died.
The chosen direction names the runner-up and the condition under which it wins.
The document names the riskiest assumption and the cheapest test that would falsify it.

evals.prompt: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings. The solution is obvious, just do it.
evals.expected_output: The reply widens the problem before narrowing: it names who is hurt, includes a remove/do-nothing option and an opposite option, and writes an idea document rather than code.
expectations: The reply states the problem before the solution.
The options include one that removes something and one that does the opposite of the obvious move.
The reply writes docs/ideas and no code.
The reply names the assumption that would kill the dark-mode direction.
